name: Positive Thinking
overview: Scripture reveals that positive thinking is deeply connected to the words we speak and the condition of our hearts. Proverbs teaches that gentle answers can defuse anger, and a joyful heart brings healing, while a broken spirit harms the body. The power of life and death rests in the tongue, showing that what we say reflects what we truly love. God’s thoughts toward His people are of peace and hope, encouraging believers to cultivate good fruit by guarding their speech and attitudes, as what proceeds from the mouth reveals the heart’s true nature.
